claim.text: GELU does not cut at zero: a negative input still leaks through, unlike a hard cutoff.

spec.explain: Toy curve from arXiv 1606.08415 showing GELU versus hard cutoff at zero. Limit is far-negative leak fading to zero while large positive tracks identity.
